message.content:
Collect REAL U.S. business leads by DIRECT web research (WebSearch + WebFetch). Do the research YOURSELF — do NOT spawn sub-agents.
⛔ NEVER fabricate — record ONLY data literally on a real page you fetched; blank ("") if not public; SKIP sites you can't fetch rather than invent. Respect ToS/robots; use businesses' OWN official sites (not directories).
CITY: St. Louis, MO (+ metro). INDUSTRIES: chiropractors, general contractors, realtors, gyms, barbers.
For each: WebSearch real local businesses, WebFetch each one's own site, extract only what's shown: businessName, category, subcategory, naics(if confident), contactFirstName/Last/Title (only if named), businessEmail, generalEmail (only if published), phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram. Website analysis via fetch: hasWebsite, ssl, mobileFriendly(null if unknown), onlineBooking, ecommerce, clearCta, websiteQuality(none/outdated/basic/modern). leadScore 0-100 (no/broken/very-outdated/no-booking-where-relevant=80-100; outdated/weak=60-79; functional-improvable=40-59; modern=20-39; excellent=0-19), leadTier. verificationStatus (Verified/Partially Verified/Unverified/Needs Review). sourceUrl REQUIRED. notes.
OUTPUT JSON array to /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/leads/w2-stlouis.json with keys: businessName,category,subcategory,naics,contactFirstName,contactLastName,contactTitle,businessEmail,generalEmail,phone,website,address,city,state,zip,linkedin,facebook,instagram,websiteQuality,hasWebsite,mobileFriendly,ssl,onlineBooking,ecommerce,clearCta,leadScore,leadTier,sourceUrl,verificationStatus,notes. Blank strings/true/false/null. Aim ~18-30 REAL businesses; NEVER pad. Return a 2-line summary.
